points.description: States the final answer that there are exactly 4 dissimilar nice triangles, with every step of the reasoning mathematically valid. Any wrong step or a wrong final answer earns nothing. The four triangles are equilateral (60-60-60), isosceles right (45-45-90), 30-60-90 and 30-30-120.

rubric.notes: Full mark only for the correct final answer, 4, with all steps valid. Any wrong step or a wrong final answer earns 0. There is no partial credit.
rubric.answer_key: 4 (the equilateral triangle, the 45-45-90 triangle, the 30-60-90 triangle and the 30-30-120 triangle).
